== Overview ==

'''NintendoNotificationEventProtocol''' is used by the Wii U and 3DS friend servers to send clients notifications about friends.

== Methods ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Method ID !! Name
|-
| 1 || [[#ProcessNintendoNotificationEvent]]
|-
| 2 || [[#ProcessNintendoNotificationEvent]]
|}

=== ProcessNintendoNotificationEvent ===

Used by the server to send a client a notification. There is no known difference between the two methods, except that the server sends some events through method 1 and others through method 2. The client treats them exactly the same.

==== Request ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| [[#NintendoNotificationEvent]] || Unknown || Notification data
|}

==== Response ====

This method does not return anything.

== Classes ==

=== NintendoNotificationEvent ===

This class holds the data about a given notification. The contents of <code>m_dataholder</code> and how it is interpreted depend on <code>m_uiType</code>.

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| UInt32 || m_uiType || [[#Notification Types]]
|-
| [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#PID|PID]] || m_pidSender || The [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#PID|PID]] of the user who triggered the action which caused the event
|-
| [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#DataHolder|DataHolder]] || m_dataholder || Actual event data. Contents depend on <code>m_uiType</code>
|}

=== NintendoNotificationEventProfile ===

<div style="background-color: rgb(234, 243, 255); border-color: rgb(163, 202, 255); border-style: solid; border-width: 1px; color: rgb(32, 33, 34); max-width: 800px; width: fit-content;">
<div style="background-color: rgb(203, 214, 246); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; height: 24px; line-height: 24px; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 5px; padding-left: 30px;">Notice</div>
<div style="padding: 5px;">This class inherits from [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#Data|Data]]</div>
</div>

This class holds data about a users profile.

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| UInt8 || m_region || Users region ID. Likely <code>CFG_Region</code> on the 3DS, <code>MCPRegion</code> on Wii U
|-
| UInt8 || m_country || Users country ID. Unknown on the 3DS, likely <code>SCIGetCafeCountry</code> on the Wii U. See https://nintendo-wiki.pretendo.network/docs/misc/region-ids (TODO: Migrate page here)
|-
| UInt8 || m_area || Users area ID. Likely https://nintendo-wiki.pretendo.network/docs/misc/region-ids (TODO: Migrate page here)
|-
| UInt8 || m_language || Users language ID. Likely the standard set of language IDs Nintendo uses. See [[Online/Nintendo_Network/IDBE#Languages|IDBE#Languages]]
|-
| UInt8 || m_platform || Users platform ID. Likely 0 = 3DS, 1 = Wii U (values from [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NNAS|NNAS]])
|}

! Type !! Method !! Platform !! Data Type !! Description
|-
| 1 || 1 || 3DS || [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Protocols/NintendoFriendPresenceProtocol#NintendoPresence|NintendoPresence]] || A friend updated their presence

|-
| 3 || 1 || 3DS || [[#NintendoNotificationEventGeneral]] || A friend changed their comment. <code>m_u64Param2</code> contains the [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#DateTime|DateTime]] the comment was updated, and <code>m_strParam</code> contains the new comment
|-

| 6 || 1 || 3DS || [[#NintendoNotificationEventProfile]] || A friend updated their profile

|-
